about.heading: About me
about.bio: I'm a backend software engineer passionate about building scalable systems and intelligent solutions. With experience across cloud architecture, AI pipelines, and distributed systems, I design software that automates processes, reduces costs, and delivers measurable value. Currently at Amazon, working globally.

I build robust, scalable systems and craft clean interfaces.
Based in Brazil, working globally.

history: My journey started in 2018 as an intern at INEP, Brazil's federal educational research agency, where I automated statisticians' daily workflows and built data pipelines for the national Census of Higher Education.

From there I joined Stefanini Brasil, where I spent nearly two years architecting AI and Machine Learning solutions for Banco do Brasil - building document classification systems, data curation platforms, and crawlers that reduced operational costs and waiting times for millions of customers.
I then moved to Serasa, where I designed the Payment System Architecture for Serasa Limpa Nome, delivering consistency and security to Brazil's largest debt rene— building docgotiation platform.

In 2022 I joined Amazon's International Technology team, working on expanding Amazon Marketplace and Amazon Flex to new countries. I was promoted to SDE II in 2024 and continue to design and ship scalable backend systems that reach customers worldwide.

Alongside Amazon, I also worked with Verbal, a healthcare AI startup, where I built cloud-native infrastructure on Kubernetes, Python-based AI pipelines, and a real-time audio ingestion system in C++ - helping automate quality assurance for healthcare communications. 🚀
